description: Exactly ten isomorphism classes and 52 labeled binary groupoids on four elements have equational probability spectrum {1/4,1}; five quasigroup classes admit explicit affine F4 representatives.
integrity: Unrestricted equations are covered by a separate vector-space linearity proof; no independently validated conclusion is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the four-element, binary-only signature is treated. The exhaustive 576-table computation is independently reproducible from embedded Python source but not formally certified. A semantically equivalent unindexed theorem remains a residual originality risk.
title: Complete four-element classification for minimal equational probability spectrum
